title: beamr's tests build offline on default features: the OpenTelemetry testing SDK is reached only through the telemetry feature
purpose: Found on 21 October 2026 at about 06:05 (Melbourne) while B-181's lane built on Tom's Mac with no network: opentelemetry_sdk 0.32.1 is a plain dev-dependency of crates/beamr (Cargo.toml:78 at beamr main dc88b857, with its `testing` feature, under [dev-dependencies] at :49), so every test build of the crate compiles it, whatever features are selected. Yet every use of it is test code of the optional telemetry feature (telemetry = ["std", "dep:opentelemetry"], :125): the unit tests in src/telemetry/spans.rs (mod tests, :296-), src/telemetry/lifecycle_tests.rs (included under #[cfg(test)] at lifecycle.rs:333-334) and the #[cfg(feature = "telemetry")] items of src/scheduler/tests.rs (:10-17 and 22 cfg sites). With the crate not on disk and no download allowed, no beamr test of any feature set can build, so the whole suite waited on a network window for a dependency that only telemetry's tests use. Waffles ruled at 06:05 (Cambium post c92ad3e1) that this is a beamr row of its own, named today. Cargo cannot make a dev-dependency optional, so the SDK moves to where only the telemetry tests reach it.
task: Make opentelemetry_sdk an optional dependency of crates/beamr enabled only by a new telemetry-testing feature that implies telemetry, put every test that uses it under that feature, and remove it from [dev-dependencies]; crates/beamr/Cargo.toml, src/telemetry/spans.rs, src/telemetry/lifecycle.rs and lifecycle_tests.rs, src/scheduler/tests.rs. The release battery and the gate's --all-features legs select it as they select telemetry today; the CHANGELOG says so.

requirements.title: A default-features test build of beamr needs no OpenTelemetry crate
requirements.spec: Behavioural. THE SYSTEM SHALL remove opentelemetry_sdk from crates/beamr's [dev-dependencies] and declare it as an optional dependency with its `testing` feature, enabled only by a new feature telemetry-testing = ["telemetry", "dep:opentelemetry_sdk"]; every test, test module and test helper that names opentelemetry_sdk (src/telemetry/spans.rs's tests, src/telemetry/lifecycle_tests.rs, the telemetry items of src/scheduler/tests.rs) SHALL compile only under cfg(all(test, feature = "telemetry-testing")). No non-test code SHALL name opentelemetry_sdk. The feature's comment SHALL say it exists only so the telemetry tests can reach the SDK's in-memory exporters, and that it is for tests, not embedders. Every cfg that names telemetry-testing SHALL be of the form cfg(all(test, ...)), so an embedder who turns the feature on gets the SDK compiled and nothing else, shown by a search of the workspace quoted in the handback.
acceptance: `cargo tree -e normal,dev -p beamr --offline` on default features lists no opentelemetry crate, quoted in the handback; today it lists opentelemetry_sdk 0.32.1.

`cargo tree -e normal,dev --workspace --offline` on default features lists no opentelemetry crate for any member (beamr-cli, beamr-wasm, gleam-types, the benches and beamr's own self dev-dependency at Cargo.toml:72), the line quoted in the handback.

With the network off and opentelemetry absent from the cargo cache (the state of Tom's Mac on 21 October), `cargo nextest run -p beamr --offline` on default features builds and runs, judged from its parsed summary; today it refuses for want of opentelemetry_sdk, and the handback quotes that refusal from a run at the base.
Every telemetry test that ran before runs under --features telemetry-testing with the same count, compared from the two runs' parsed lists.
A search of the workspace for telemetry-testing finds it only in Cargo.toml and in cfg(all(test, ...)) attributes, quoted in the handback.

requirements.title: The gate and the release battery still run the telemetry tests, and the CHANGELOG says how
requirements.spec: Documentary and behavioural. The gate's --all-features legs SHALL select telemetry-testing as they select telemetry, so no telemetry test leaves the battery; CHANGELOG.md SHALL say that opentelemetry_sdk is no longer a dev-dependency and that the telemetry tests run under --features telemetry-testing or --all-features.
acceptance: The handback names every gate or battery file that selects features and shows telemetry-testing reached by each --all-features leg, and quotes the CHANGELOG lines.

boundaries: SHALL NOT change what the telemetry feature gives an embedder, or any non-test code.
SHALL NOT drop, skip or #[ignore] a telemetry test.
SHALL NOT add a dependency; opentelemetry_sdk moves, it is not added.
verification: This handwritten brief passes the design gate of this repository, judged by its parsed failures, never by its exit code.

The default-features nextest of R1 green offline on Tom's Mac; the --all-features legs (clippy, nextest, cargo test --doc) green on the exact final commit in the network window's first hour, judged from parsed output, with df and the swap line in START and END.
Four-heading handback (BLOCKED ON, CHANGED, FOUND, NOT CONFIRMED).
Ships in B-181's release; liminal and haematite move their beamr pins the same day (Tom's rule 16).
